# Security Policy

## Reporting Security Issues

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project or site, please report it privately via email:

- **Email:** flagon_plazas0x@icloud.com
- **Policy & Scope:** https://cyber.peterjaycox.com/security.html
- **RFC 9116 security.txt:** https://cyber.peterjaycox.com/.well-known/security.txt

Please do not open public GitHub issues or discussions for security vulnerabilities.

### Scope

In scope:
- Stored/reflected XSS or injection flaws in client-side app pages (`stories.html`, `globe.html`, `flashcards.html`, `matrix.html`).
- Malicious vectors affecting site visitors.
- Supply-chain / dependency integrity issues.

Out of scope:
- Underlying hosting provider infrastructure (GitHub Pages / Cloudflare).
- DoS / DDoS against static CDNs.
- Social engineering / spam.

We aim to acknowledge reports within 7 days and provide a resolution timeline within 30 days.
